## Information
Bring a fresh botanical feel to your home with this beautiful Artificial Greenery Wreath, designed with realistic-looking faux fern leaves and lush foliage. Perfect for adding colour, texture and natural-inspired style to your front door, porch, wall or indoor space. This artificial fern wreath is a versatile decoration that can be enjoyed all year round. Unlike real foliage, it requires no watering, trimming or specialist care, making it an easy way to keep your home looking fresh and inviting. Simply display it on your front door, wall, window or anywhere that needs a decorative touch of greenery. Ideal for both everyday home decoration and special occasions, this faux greenery wreath can be used to create a welcoming entrance for guests or complement your existing décor. It is suitable for front doors, porches, hallways, living rooms, conservatories, garden rooms, weddings, parties and celebrations. The timeless fern design makes this wreath easy to style with a wide range of interiors and exterior décor. Use it on its own for a simple natural look or pair it with ribbons, flowers, lights and other decorations to create your own personalised display. A stylish and practical alternative to fresh foliage, this artificial fern wreath is a simple way to bring the beauty of greenery into your home without the ongoing maintenance of real plants.

## Information
Our 180cm Christmas Garland with Berries & Pinecones combines lush, full green foliage with a rich mix of natural-style pinecones and berry clusters – the kind of abundant, layered look that instantly makes a mantelpiece, staircase, or doorway feel warm and welcoming. The mixed detailing gives this garland real visual depth – the varied textures of berry clusters and pinecones sitting against dense green foliage create a richly decorated finish that looks considered and styled. Pliable, lightweight, and 180cm long, it shapes easily to any space and stores compactly at the end of the season – making it a reliable, fuss-free Christmas staple you'll look forward to bringing out each year. Ideal for: Fireplace mantels, staircase banisters, doorways, windowsills, dining table centrepieces, and traditional or contemporary Christmas displays. Please Note: For indoor use only. Storage: Fold gently and store in a cool dry place between seasons. Reshape branches each year for the best result. Care: Wipe with a dry or lightly damp cloth to remove dust. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Plain spruce pre-lit garland for indoor or outdoor display
- Warm white & multi-colour LEDs with built-in colour switch
- IP44-rated battery pack with timer (6 hours on / 18 hours off)
- 140 / 180 tapered PVC tips for a full natural look
- Available in 6ft and 9ft lengths with loops for easy hanging

## Information
Bring festive greenery to your home with this Christow Plain Spruce Pre-Lit Christmas Garland. Available in 6ft and 9ft sizes, it’s beautifully illuminated by LEDs to add a magical festive glow to doorways, banisters, windowsills, and fireplaces. Switch the LEDs from warm white to multi-coloured to create the perfect festive mood, with a battery-powered design and built-in timer for easy indoor and outdoor display. Colour Switch LEDs & Light Effects Switch from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs to set the perfect festive mood. From gentle fades and twinkles to colour-changing displays, choose from a variety of light effects, with a memory chip remembering your last setting. Realistic Spruce Style Crafted with dual-toned PVC needles, the garland captures the look and colour of real spruce foliage. Soft tapered tips add texture and depth for a full, natural finish, creating a stunning backdrop for the LEDs and your favourite decorations. Battery Powered with Timer Powered by an IP44-rated battery pack, the garland can be displayed indoors or outdoors without worrying about plugging it in. A built-in timer conveniently switches the LEDs on at the same time every evening, then turns them off six hours later. Loops for Easy Hanging Durable metal loops on both ends make the garland easy to hang around doors, banisters, fireplaces, and more. Coloured green to blend with the foliage, the loops also make it easy to tie more than one garland together for a longer display. Product Specifications: Available Sizes: 6ft / 9ft Tip Style: Tapered PVC tips Tip Count: 140 (6ft), 180 (9ft) LED Count: 40 (6ft), 50 (9ft) Colour Switch LEDs: Warm white and multi-colour Lighting Functions: 11 settings Memory Function: Remembers last setting selected Timer Function: 6 hours on / 18 hours off Power: Battery powered Battery Pack: IP44-rated for indoor and outdoor use Lead Wire: 30cm Batteries: Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included) Hanging Loops: Green metal loops on both ends

## Features
- Snow flocked pre-lit garland for indoor or outdoor display
- Warm white & multi-colour LEDs with built-in colour switch
- IP44-rated battery pack with timer (6 hours on / 18 hours off)
- 140 / 200 flocked tapered PVC tips for a full festive look
- Available in 6ft and 9ft lengths with loops for easy hanging

## Information
Bring a snowy festive feel to your home with this Christow Snow Flocked Pre-Lit Christmas Garland. Available in 6ft and 9ft sizes, it’s beautifully illuminated by LEDs to add a magical glow to doorways, banisters, windowsills, and fireplaces. Switch the LEDs from warm white to multi-coloured to create the perfect festive mood, with a battery-powered design and built-in timer for easy display. Colour Switch LEDs & Light Effects Switch from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs to set the perfect festive mood. From gentle fades and twinkles to colour-changing displays, choose from a variety of light effects, with a memory chip remembering your last setting. Realistic Snow Flocked Style Crafted with flocked dual-toned PVC needles, the garland captures the look of real snow-dusted foliage for a magical wintry look. Soft tapered tips add texture and depth for a full, natural finish, creating a stunning frosted backdrop for the LEDs. Battery Powered with Timer Powered by an IP44-rated battery pack, the garland can be displayed indoors or outdoors without worrying about plugging it in. A built-in timer conveniently switches the LEDs on at the same time every evening, then turns them off six hours later. Loops for Easy Hanging Durable metal loops on both ends make the garland easy to hang around doors, banisters, fireplaces, and more. Coloured green to blend with the foliage, the loops also make it easy to tie more than one garland together for a longer display. ## Information
Decoris red foil lametta garland. FESTIVE TOUCH - Bring festive sparkle and warmth to your holiday decor with this red foil lametta tinsel in a vibrant, shiny Christmas red. This beautiful foil lametta is ideal for adding a touch of glamour to Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, or festive displays. DAZZLING RED - Crafted in a rich, shiny red, this lametta tinsel enhances your holiday decor with classic Christmas color and a high gloss finish. The red foil catches and reflects light beautifully, making it perfect for both day and night displays where it creates a warm, festive glow under lights or natural sunlight. VERSATILE SIZE - The generous 50cm x 40cm size provides plenty of coverage for various decorating needs. It's long enough to drape elegantly on trees, wrap around garlands, add volume to wreaths, or enhance table top displays. Its versatility allows you to use it creatively in any area that needs a bit of festive sparkle. REFLECTS LIGHT - This shiny red tinsel captures and reflects light beautifully, adding extra sparkle to any setting. Whether paired with Christmas tree lights, candles, or holiday decor, it amplifies the festive atmosphere by creating a radiant, cosy glow that brightens up your home. EASY TO ARRANGE - The tinsels thin, flexible strands make it easy to shape, spread, and arrange just the way you like. Drape it loosely for a more natural effect, or bunch it for a denser look. It's lightweight, making it simple to attach or layer in different parts of your decor, from branches to tables.

Create a warm and traditional festive display with the GloBrite Wooden Christmas Candle Bridge. Crafted from wood and decorated with a detailed Santa village scene, this Christmas arch features 10 warm white LED lights to create a cosy seasonal glow. Finished in a polished traditional style, this reusable wooden decoration brings timeless Christmas charm to your home year after year.

## Features
- Wooden Advent blocks to create your very own Christmas Countdown.
- Adorable Christmas Characters each holding wooden blocks for turning.

Pre-personalised with poular childrens names and family members, these cute festive characters each hold wooden numbered advent blocks for turning and counting down to Christmas day. With dangly legs and jingle bells for an added fun factor. Our Personalised Christmas Advent blocks bring festive cheer to any home. PLEASE NOTE: These items are pre-personalised. - Wooden Advent blocks to create your very own Christmas Countdown.
- Adorable Christmas Characters each holding wooden blocks for turning.
- In festive colours featuring dangly legs and jingle bells for added fun.
- Over 80 names and titles available
- Use the search bar to find your name

## Information
Pre-personalised with poular childrens names and family members, these cute festive characters each hold wooden numbered advent blocks for turning and counting down to Christmas day. Painted in festive colourways, there's a Snowman, Father Christmas or a reindeer to choose from and even a blank version to write your own name choice on. With dangly legs and jingle bells for an added fun factor. Our Personalised Christmas Advent blocks bring festive cheer to any home. PLEASE NOTE: These items are pre-personalised. The item you receive is the name or title that you have selected. Items are not personalised to order and we do not offer bespoke customisation.

- Wooden Advent blocks to create your very own Christmas Countdown.
- Adorable Christmas Characters each holding wooden blocks for turning.
- In festive colours featuring dangly legs and jingle bells for added fun.
- Over 80 names and titles available

## Information
Pre-personalised with poular childrens names and family members, these cute festive characters each hold wooden numbered advent blocks for turning and counting down to Christmas day. Painted in festive colourways, there's a Snowman, Father Christmas or a reindeer to choose from and even a blank version to write your own name choice on. With dangly legs and jingle bells for an added fun factor. Our Personalised Christmas Advent blocks bring festive cheer to any home. PLEASE NOTE: These items are pre-personalised. ## Information
Welcome spring into your home with Homescapes' handmade British spring decor and Easter ornaments. Crafted from luxurious materials, including real wood, this collection is elegant and features delicately speckled Easter egg decorations and lifelike leaves, from olive leaves to eucalyptus leaves, perfect for adding charm and colour to your home decor. Our evergreen collection is easy to care for and includes flower picks, spring garlands, artificial eucalyptus stems, and floral wreaths. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Elegant woodland design
- Heat-resistant & durable
- Perfect for entertaining

## Information
Set a sophisticated tone for your seasonal hosting with an expertly curated tableware collection designed to elevate the traditional Christmas feast into a refined culinary event. The muted palette of rich pine greens and delicate metallic accents pairs beautifully with crisp white crockery and polished silverware, allowing you to create a striking centerpiece without overwhelming your dining room. Each piece is precision-crafted to sit flat and square, lending an immediate sense of structured order and timeless hotel-quality luxury to your festive layout, Beyond its elegant visual presence, this set delivers uncompromising utility for the modern household. The hardwearing, non-slip cork base acts as a natural acoustic dampener, softening the clatter of cutlery and glassware to foster a relaxed, intimate dining atmosphere. Maintenance requires nothing more than a swift wipe with a damp cloth, giving you more time to enjoy the company of your guests while keeping your table impeccably dressed throughout the entire holiday season.

## Features
- Heavy and Robust Metal Stand
- Colour Black
- Tree size up to 3m 9ft 8in
- Trunk width up to 15cm 6in
- Water capacity 2.6 litres
- Dimensions 72cm x 19cm
- Detachable legs for easy storage

## Information
Heavier trees with wider trunks are now being produced by many UK growers and this is especially true of the Nordman variety if Christmas Tree. We are addressing that with this versatile, heavy duty metal stand that can hold trees up to 3m (9ft 8") tall and with a trunk of up to 15cm (6") in diameter.Strong metal construction with a powder coating finish and detachable legs means this stand is easy to store so will last for many years. The tree is held straight and securely with 4 strong thumb screws and a centre pin to the base of the vessel. The vessel has a high water holding capacity of 2.6l making this overall one of our best Christmas Tree stands. Easy to assemble , comes with Instructions and Allen key so no tools required.

## Features
- Rotating gold star with 3 adjustable speed levels
- Projects glowing snowflake patterns onto ceilings and walls
- Remote control with power, pause, flash, brightness, and speed settings
- Secure clip fixing for stable attachment to your tree

## Information
Add a magical finishing touch to your Christmas tree with this Gold Star Topper. Featuring a rotating star design that projects sparkling snowflake patterns across your ceiling, it brings dynamic, festive light to any room. Fully remote-controlled with adjustable speed, brightness, and flash settings, it's the statement piece that transforms a tree from decorated to spectacular. Key features Rotating gold star with 3 adjustable speed levels Projects glowing snowflake patterns onto ceilings and walls Remote control with power, pause, flash, brightness, and speed settings Auto-off timer — set to switch off after 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours Secure clip fixing for stable attachment to your tree What's included 1 x Gold Star Topper (with attached power cable and mounting clip) 1 x Remote control How to use Open the clip and attach the star to the highest, most stable point of your tree — avoid placing on a weak branch Plug the adapter into the mains Use the remote to turn on/off, pause rotation, select flash mode, adjust brightness or rotation speed, and set the auto-off timer Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Returns accepted within 30 days Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs Does the star rotate? Yes — the star rotates with 3 adjustable speed levels, controlled via the included remote. How is it powered? The star itself is mains-powered via the attached UK plug adapter. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (battery not included) Can I set it to turn off automatically? Yes. The remote includes a timer function to automatically switch off after 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours. How do I attach it to my tree? Open the clip and fix it to the highest, most stable point on your tree structure. Avoid attaching it to a weak or thin branch. Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. Is it covered by a warranty? Yes. It comes with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. How is it delivered? Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets. The remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious internal injury if swallowed, sometimes within hours. If a battery is swallowed or you suspect ingestion, seek immediate medical attention. Ensure the battery compartment is securely closed at all times.

- Flocked white "snow" finish on PE pine needle branches
- Pre-lit with 50 multi-colour LEDs, multi-function lighting
- Powered by 3xAA batteries (not included)

## Information
Bring a touch of winter magic to your front door with the Aurora Winter Glow Christmas Wreath. Flocked in soft white "snow" and finished with pinecones and frosted berries, this 60cm wreath is pre-lit with 50 multi-colour LEDs and a built-in timer, adding a warm festive glow day or night — indoors or outdoor use (IP44 rated). Key features 60cm diameter wreath with 88 branch tips for a full, realistic shape Flocked white "snow" finish on PE pine needle branches Pre-lit with 50 multi-colour LEDs, multi-function lighting Built-in timer: 8 hours on / 16 hours off for automatic daily use Finished with 5 pinecones and 5 berry clusters IP44 rated — suitable for covered outdoor areas Battery-operated — display anywhere, no nearby socket needed What's included 1 x Aurora Winter Glow Christmas Wreath Dimensions 60cm (Diameter) Good to know Powered by battery box (3xAA batteries required, not included) IP44 rated — suitable for sheltered outdoor use (e.g. covered porches, front doors) Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Returns accepted within 30 days Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty Contains small parts (berries/pinecones) — keep away from children FAQs Does it need assembly? ## Features
- 270cm (9ft) length with 180 branch tips for a full, realistic look
- Flocked white "snow" finish on PE pine needle branches
- Pre-lit with 70 warm white LEDs, IP44 rated
- Flexible branches for easy shaping around banisters, mantels, or doorframes
- Powered by 3xAA batteries (not included)

## Information
Add a stunning frosted finish to your staircase, mantel or doorway with the Aurora Winter Glow Christmas Garland. Flocked in soft white "snow" along realistic PE pine-needle branches, this generously full garland is finished with natural pinecones and frosted red berries for a beautifully festive winter look. Pre-lit with 70 warm white LEDs, the Aurora Winter Glow adds a soft, welcoming glow to your display — perfect for draping along banisters, mantels, or doorframes throughout the festive season. Key features 270cm (9ft) length with 180 branch tips for a full, realistic look Flocked white "snow" finish on PE pine needle branches Pre-lit with 70 warm white LEDs, IP44 rated Finished with 8 pinecones and 8 berry clusters Battery-operated — display anywhere, no nearby socket needed Flexible branches for easy shaping around banisters, mantels, or doorframes What's included 1 x Aurora Winter Glow Christmas Garland Dimensions Length: 270cm (9ft) Good to know Powered by battery box (3xAA batteries required, not included) IP44 rated — suitable for sheltered outdoor use (e.g. covered porches, entranceways) Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Returns accepted within 30 days Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty Contains small parts (berries/pinecones) — keep away from children FAQs Does it need assembly? No assembly required. Simply unfold and shape the branches, then drape or position as desired. How are the lights powered? The garland is battery-operated (batteries required, not included), making it easy to display anywhere without needing a nearby plug socket. What colour are the lights? The garland is lit with warm white LEDs for a soft, cosy glow. Can I use it outdoors? Yes. This garland is IP44 rated, making it suitable for covered/sheltered outdoor areas such as porches or entranceways. It's not recommended for direct exposure to heavy rain. Is it safe around children and pets? The garland contains small decorative parts (berries and pinecones) that may pose a choking hazard. We recommend keeping it out of reach of young children and pets who may be tempted to chew or pull them off. Is it covered by a warranty? Yes. It comes with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. How is it delivered? Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery.

The bulbs are set 5cm apart to ensure that you get a full festive glow over this Christmas period. SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: These lights are extra safe due to the low-voltage, mains-powered UK plug with a 31V low voltage adapter, which is IP44 rated, meaning that you can use this product both indoors and outdoors. A 5M lead wire ensures easy installation of these lights. EASY TO USE: No batteries are required for this product making them super-easy to use. Just plug in and switch on to add a warm, festive glow to any room or area. They are safe to touch whilst they are on and have a 10M lit length to save you from struggling whilst creating your seasonal scene. 365-DAY WARRANTY: We hope that you love these lights, but on the off-chance that you don't, NETTA provides a full 365-day warranty on this product. ## Features
- Stunning 36-Piece Ornament Set: Includes 18 small (1.57" / 40mm), 12 medium (2.36" / 60mm), and 6 large (3.15" / 80mm) Christmas tree balls for a full, balanced tree display.
- Variety of Finishes: A mix of matte, shiny, glitter, disco, and patterned baubles to create dimension and sparkle.
- Multi-Season Use: Ideal not only for Christmas but also for Halloween tree decorations, add a spooky or festive touch to your home décor.
- Premium Quality & Durability: Crafted with high-quality, long-lasting materials designed to shimmer and shine year after year.
- Easy to Hang: Each ornament includes a pre-attached hanging loop for quick and effortless decorating.
- Elegant Home Décor: Perfect for Christmas parties, living rooms, offices, or event decorations, these copper-orange baubles bring a warm glow and luxury appeal.
- Mix & Match Options: Available in a wide colour range to complement any holiday theme or interior design.

## Information
Transform your home into a festive wonderland with our stunning Neo Christmas Tree Ornament Decorations. Perfect for Christmas, parties, and even Halloween tree decorations, these dazzling baubles and glitter balls bring sparkle and sophistication to any setting. Whether you're decking the halls or hosting a holiday event, these ornaments will elevate your décor with timeless elegance. Add a magical touch to your festive celebrations with these sparkling Christmas ball ornaments. Whether you prefer a traditional, modern, or whimsical theme, our Christmas bauble decorations are designed to make your tree shine brighter than ever.

## Information
Add a warm, festive glow with NETTA 5m LED warm white fairy string lights, ideal for Christmas, weddings, parties and outdoor décor. Features a mains UK plug with low-voltage IP44 adapter for safe indoor and outdoor use, and a 5m lead for easy installation. Choose from 8 lighting modes with memory—Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash—using the control button on the plug. Built-in timer lets lights run 8 hours on and 16 hours off (hold power button 3 seconds to enable or disable). Bulbs are spaced 5 cm apart for consistent coverage. Includes a 365-day warranty and manufacturer support from NETTA.
CHRISTMAS FAIRY LIGHTS: Let your home shine brighter with this set of NETTA LED Multi-Coloured Christmas Fairy Lights that feature 500 beaming bulbs. These lustrous lights are sure to add a sparkle to your home or a glimmer to your garden over the festive season by enhancing the traditional Christmas theme. Not only are they perfect for Christmas, but they are ideal for any outdoor gathering or for serving a desirable decoration for parties and events. 8 FUNCTIONS WITH MEMORY: This set of multifunctional string lights features 8 lighting modes to choose from, including Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash. The different lighting effects are controlled by a button on the plug adapter which make it easier than ever to achieve your desired lighting effects. The bulbs are set 5cm apart to ensure that you get a full festive glow over this Christmas period. SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: These lights are extra safe due to the low-voltage, mains-powered UK plug with a 31V low voltage adapter, which is IP44 rated, meaning that you can use this product both indoors and outdoors. A 5M lead wire ensures easy installation of these lights. EASY TO USE: No batteries are required for this product making them super-easy to use. Just plug in and switch on to add a warm, festive glow to any room or area. They are safe to touch whilst they are on and have a 50M lit length to save you from struggling whilst creating your seasonal scene. 365-DAY WARRANTY: We hope that you love these lights, but on the off-chance that you don't, NETTA provides a full 365-day warranty on this product. If you are not completely satisfied with this item, please don't hesitate to contact our customer service department.

## Features
- Create a cheerful Christmas display with this 240cm tall inflatable Father Christmas featuring a friendly waving pose. Perfect for gardens, front lawns, driveways and festive entrances.
- Built-in electric blower inflates Santa automatically in approximately 12 minutes. Simply connect the blower cable to the supplied power adapter and plug into a suitable AC 220240V outlet.
- Includes two water bags for added stability. Fill with water, secure the caps tightly and insert into the base or feet through the bottom zipper, ensuring it is fully closed.
- Secure your outdoor inflatable Santa using the five included plastic ground stakes and 1.5m tethers. Attach to the side loops and position stakes at a 45° angle in grass for a firm hold.
- Made from lightweight, tear-resistant polyester fabric for repeated seasonal use. Easy to maintain by wiping clean with a damp cloth.
- Easily deflates after Christmas for convenient storage. Simply disconnect the power, empty the water bags and allow all components to dry thoroughly before packing away.
- An eye-catching festive decoration ideal for Christmas gardens, front lawns, seasonal parties and welcoming guests throughout the festive season.

## Information
Bring festive cheer to your home with this Inflatable Santa Claus Christmas Decoration, perfect for creating a welcoming Christmas display in your garden, front lawn, driveway or festive entrance. Featuring a cheerful smiling face and friendly waving pose, this inflatable Father Christmas adds seasonal charm to any outdoor setting. Designed for quick and easy assembly, the built-in electric blower inflates Santa in approximately 1–2 minutes. Simply connect the blower cable securely to the supplied power adapter and plug into a suitable AC 220–240V outlet. For added stability, the decoration includes two 500ml water weight bags, which can be filled, securely capped and inserted into the base or feet through the bottom zipper. Ensure the zipper is fully closed before use. Five plastic ground stakes and securing tethers are also included to help anchor Santa firmly in position. Attach the tethers to the side loops and insert the stakes into grass at approximately a 45° angle for additional support. Crafted from durable, tear-resistant 210T polyester, this outdoor inflatable Christmas decoration is lightweight, easy to clean and designed for repeated seasonal use. Once Christmas is over, simply disconnect the power, allow Santa to deflate, empty the water bags and ensure everything is thoroughly dry before folding away for compact storage. Ideal for Christmas garden displays, festive parties and seasonal home decorations, this waving inflatable Santa Claus is a delightful way to spread Christmas cheer.

## Information
Embrace timeless elegance with this stunningly realistic artificial eucalyptus spray. Presented in a sophisticated, muted silver-grey tone, this piece perfectly captures the popular aesthetic of dried or preserved eucalyptus. The design features a single, detailed main stem that gracefully divides into three distinct heads, each adorned with the iconic, disc-shaped leaves of the eucalyptus plant. This spray is ideal for adding a touch of understated, modern texture to any space. Its delicate and airy structure makes it a beautiful standalone feature in a minimalist vase or a versatile filler component for floral arrangements, wreaths, and wedding bouquets. Enjoy the lasting beauty of this botanical favourite without any need for water or care.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Approximate 6ft / 180cm length for mantels, windowsills and banisters
- Integrated warm white LEDs for a cosy, inviting festive glow
- Brown artificial twig branches with delicate snow-dusted detailing
- Battery operated using 3 x AA batteries for placement away from sockets
- Convenient timer function for easy everyday seasonal lighting
- 40cm lead wire for discreet positioning of the battery pack
- Slender branching design for Christmas table centrepieces and wall displays
- Rustic woodland styling to complement neutral and traditional Christmas décor, also suitable for year-round use

## Information
Add a soft seasonal glow to your home with this 6ft (180cm) pre-lit twig Christmas garland, featuring brown artificial branches with a delicate snow-dusted finish. Warm white LED lights illuminate the slender twigs, creating an elegant woodland decoration for festive and winter displays. Arrange this light-up branch garland across a mantelpiece, along a windowsill or around a staircase banister to highlight your favourite spaces. Its open, branching design also makes an attractive Christmas table centrepiece, adding decorative light between place settings. Arrange across a console table or shelf, or use as a Christmas table centrepiece for an understated botanical display. This ensures that your cushion remains as fresh and inviting as your holiday celebrations, year after year. Rest easy knowing that the filling conforms to British standards, guaranteeing both quality and safety. ## Features
- 25cm star 20 warm white LEDs indoor outdoor glow
- Battery timer 50cm lead easy hassle free control
- Versatile hanging for porches trees windows decor

## Information
Illuminate your holiday season with the Pre-Lit Warm White Micro LED Christmas Hanging Light. This enchanting decoration features an intricate 25cm star design, adorned with 20 delicate micro LEDs that cast a soft and inviting glow. Perfect for creating a cosy atmosphere, this light adds a magical touch to any festive setting. With a generous 50cm lead and a convenient battery-operated timer function, decorating has never been easier or more versatile. Whether you choose to hang it indoors or outdoors, on porches, brackets, ceilings, trees, bushes, or windows, this elegant piece is sure to bring festive charm wherever it is displayed. Crafted with a sleek white frame, the illuminated design exudes timeless elegance and sophistication, enhancing the ambiance of any space. The light is supplied fully assembled with a hanging chain and comes packaged in a sturdy box for convenient storage, making it easy to enjoy year after year. Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included), ensuring long-lasting illumination throughout the festive season.

## Features
- Large Silver Christmas Bauble
- Diameter: 14cm approx.
- Colour: Silver
- Shatterproof

## Information
Large 14cm Silver Christmas Bauble BOLD APPEAL - Make a bold festive statement with this luxurious 14cm Silver Christmas Bauble, a showstopper designed to bring elegance and brilliance to your seasonal decor. With its substantial size and gleaming reflective surface, this bauble is perfect for creating a sophisticated Christmas display that exudes festive glamour and timeless charm. LUSTROUS SILVER FINISH - The high-gloss coating produces a flawless, polished shine, capturing twinkling tree lights and surrounding decorations like a mirror for a dazzling, radiant effect. The neutral silver shade harmonises effortlessly with all colour schemes, traditional red and green, opulent gold, champagne tones, frosty whites, or contemporary blush and navy palettes. GENEROUS SIZE - Larger than standard baubles, at an impressive 14cm diameter, this piece is designed to stand out among your decorations, immediately drawing the eye and adding a sense of scale and luxury. Perfect proportion for grand displays. Ideal for large trees, high-ceiling rooms, shop displays, event decor, or windows where smaller baubles may be lost. EASY TO HANG - A polished silver cap securely attached with a traditional finish, enhancing the luxurious appearance of the bauble. Ready to Hang # Simply attach with the color coordinated string included , or use a decoration hook to coordinate with your theme. FAMILY FRIENDLY - Made from shatterproof recycled plastic, this bauble is safe for use around children and pets, no sharp shards if dropped. Lightweight & easy to hang, this bauble is perfect for both real and artificial trees, working beautifully as a statement ornament amongst smaller baubles and lights.

## Information
Transform your home into a mesmerizing winter wonderland with these String Lights. This stunning set of string lights spans 18.7 meters in length, creating a magical ambience that captures the essence of the holiday season. Specifically designed for Christmas trees, LEDs are spaced approximately 2.5cm apart on a green wire, giving three times as many bulbs per metre than regular lights. Easy to place with a 5m lead length from the UK 3-pin transformer to the first bulb. Switch through the 8 available functions with the press of a dual-purpose button on the transformer. The button can be held in to activate and deactivate the 8 hours on / 16 hours off timer function, the timer is active when the button is illuminated. This set contains a built-in memory chip which allows the previous setting to be remembered. Available functions: static, combination, in waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing/flash, slow fade and twinkle/flash. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, with an IP-20 rated transformer that must be kept dry at all times. ECO-friendly non-replaceable bulbs - save up to 90% on energy costs. Not just for Christmas, this set can be used at any point of the year and in a variety of ways, ideal for providing ambient lighting and creating eye-catching scenes.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 24 days of consecutive blind box surprises
- Exquisite Christmas Gift Box Design
- Made from safe, non-toxic materials, giving parents peace of mind.

## Information
24 days of consecutive blind box surprises: featuring 24 individually numbered blind box compartments—open one each day to discover a different ‘baozi’ soft toy, the perfect way to count down to Christmas Eve. 24 unique and adorable designs: featuring baozi and jiaozi fairies in a variety of colours, including white, pink, green, purple, yellow and blue. Wearing Santa hats, scarves and reindeer antlers, their expressions are soft and cute, making them highly collectable. Bouncy, stress-relieving squishy toy: Made from high-quality soft rubber, it feels soft to the touch and bounces back quickly. Simply kneading it in your hands can effectively soothe your mood, making it a stress-relief favourite for both children and adults. Exquisite Christmas Gift Box Design: The outer box features illustrations of a wintry night’s snowy landscape and a little log cabin, brimming with festive atmosphere. It includes a built-in ‘Days Until Christmas: 24’ countdown card, making it a ready-to-give gift that requires no further wrapping. Versatile and Interactive: Perfect for families to enjoy unboxing and playing together every day; the items can also serve as festive table decorations, miniature dioramas or party favours. Made from safe, non-toxic materials, giving parents peace of mind.

## Features

- LED telephone box with Santa scene
- White LEDs

## Information
Telephone Box Water Spinner 27cm. This Telephone Box Christmas Glitter Water Spinner with White LEDs is a charming and festive holiday decoration that combines the classic British telephone box design with the enchanting beauty of a snow globe. This Christmas decoration is designed to resemble a classic British telephone box, which is an iconic symbol of the United Kingdom. It's crafted with meticulous attention to detail, including the distinct red color and the iconic phone booth design. Inside the telephone box, there is a water spinner filled with water and glitter. When activated, the glitter swirls and floats within the water, creating a magical and snow globe-like effect. White LED lights are integrated into the decoration to illuminate the water spinner and add a white bright glow reminiscent of holiday lights. The LEDs enhance the festive ambiance and provide a cozy, wintery feel. The inside of the water spinner also features a festive holiday scene, which includes miniature figurine of Father Christmas. This scene is brought to life as the glitter swirls around it. The swirling glitter inside the water spinner mimics falling snow, creating a snowy atmosphere that evokes the magic of a winter wonderland. This festive duel powered decoration can be powered by batteries or an electrical cord, providing flexibility in placement. Batteries and transformer are not included and must be purchased separately. The Telephone Box Christmas Glitter Water Spinner measures approximately 27cm in height, 10cm in width and 10cm in length overall and makes the perfect decoration to be placed on a table top or mantel, making it a focal point of your holiday decor.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Thick cut wood for insulation
- Value packs birdhouses
- Ideal for Robins

## Information
These nest boxes are ideal for most garden birds and offer 1.5cm thick wooden walls for insulation. Perfect for Robins in particular, these birdhouses come in a great value pack of two allowing you to position them at different vantage points. During the colder months, providing shelter for our garden visitors is essential, and these sturdy bird boxes are a perfect welcome for our feathered friends. It is recommended that you site Robin nest boxes no more than 1 - 2 metres high. Open fronted nest boxes are preferred by Robins, Wrens, Pied Wagtails etc. Key benefits: Open fronted design: Mimics how the Robin would nest in the wild with high visibility Thick cut wood for insulation: 15mm thick wooden construction for security and insulation Appeals to a variety of birds: Not only Robins but also Wrens, Blackbirds and Pied Wagtails can use this nester

- Pre-lit warm white LEDs to help you create an inviting festive display straight away; no need to add separate string lights before decorating your room
- 8 lighting modes including waves, sequential, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination settings so you can tailor the atmosphere at home
- natural-looking green Alaskan pine style gives this artificial Christmas tree a classic seasonal appearance with plenty of space for baubles and ornament
- Wrapped construction with hinged sections helps assembly feel more straightforward once fitted together, arrange the branches carefully for final shape
- build with an included metal stand provides practical indoor support for reusable festive decorating year after year in small to medium-sized rooms
- Hinged branches support straightforward assembly and can be shaped for a fuller, more natural appearance.
- Mains-powered lighting with a 2 m cable allows convenient placement near a suitable indoor power outlet.
- The included metal stand helps keep the tree stable when displayed indoors throughout the festive season.
- Partial assembly is required, with branches arranged and fluffed after setup to create the finished shape.
- Fire-retardant construction is suitable for indoor festive displays.

## Information
Bring a cosy festive feel to your home with this 5ft pre-lit artificial Christmas tree, designed to suit small to medium-sized rooms. The natural-looking green Alaskan pine style creates a classic seasonal centrepiece while offering plenty of space for hanging baubles, garlands and other decorative ornaments. With warm white LEDs already fitted, it helps you achieve an inviting display without the need to add separate lights yourself. The tree is made from PVC and metal for a practical reusable decoration that can be brought out year after year. Its wrapped construction helps the branches settle into shape after installation, and the included metal stand provides stable support for indoor display throughout the Christmas season. This tree measures 5ft / 1.5m / 150cm including the stand, with an approximate width of 80cm and around 350 tips for a fuller seasonal look. It includes 130 warm white LEDs built in, giving you a soft glow that works well for relaxed family settings or traditional festive decorating. You can choose from 8 lighting modes: waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination, allowing you to adjust the atmosphere to suit different occasions. The hinged construction makes assembly more straightforward, while the quick and easy setup is supported by the pre-lit design so you can spend less time wiring lights and more time arranging your decorations. Because the branches are supplied ready to shape after assembly, you can arrange them to help achieve the best possible appearance once installed. The tree’s green colour and natural styling make it a versatile option for living rooms, hallways or other indoor spaces where you want a festive focal point without using a real tree. The PVC construction offers a practical balance of appearance and durability, while the metal stand adds dependable support during use. Whether you prefer a simple traditional look or a more decorated finish with ornaments added by hand, this pre-lit artificial Christmas tree provides a flexible base for your seasonal display. Ideal for households looking for an artificial Christmas tree that combines convenience with a classic look, this model offers built-in lighting and a manageable size for many homes. The warm white LEDs create a welcoming ambience from the moment it is switched on, and the selectable light modes let you vary the effect across different gatherings or times of day. Assembling the tree is designed to be straightforward: once installed, simply arrange the branches carefully so they open out evenly and present their best shape. With its wrapped construction, included stand and reusable materials, it is a practical choice for creating an attractive festive setting indoors year after year. The overall design focuses on ease of use as well as decoration. Instead of needing to source separate lights or additional support accessories, this tree arrives ready to set up with essential features already included. The combination of green PVC foliage, metal structure and warm white illumination gives it broad appeal for homes wanting an accessible seasonal centrepiece. Its size makes it suitable where space matters, while still offering enough presence to feel like a proper Christmas feature in your room. For customers seeking an artificial tree with pre-fitted lighting, multiple light settings and a natural green finish, this 5ft option provides a balanced mix of style and practicality.

Elevate your Christmas ambience with these 500 LED Indoor Outdoor Christmas Multi-Function Mains Operated String Lights with Timer in Multicoloured. Designed to illuminate your holiday celebrations, these lights are perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. With LEDs spaced apart on a green wire, you'll enjoy three times as many bulbs per meter compared to regular lights, adding a brilliant radiance to your Christmas tree. Whether for your Christmas tree or other decorative uses, these lights come in an array of LED counts to suit your needs, making your festive display truly memorable.

- Enchanting Infinity Mirror Effect
- Traditional Santa & Tree Scene

Celebrate the festive season in style with this 60cm Light up Standing Santa with Tree Infinity Mirror. A captivating decorative piece that combines traditional Christmas imagery with striking modern lighting effects. Perfect for adding a warm and magical touch to your indoor decor. Mains powered and supplied with a generous 5 metre power cable, allowing you the freedom to position it without the restriction of wires and plug sockets. Suitable for indoor use only.

- A shimmering gold weave finish combines with sleek conical shapes to create an elegant centrepiece for Christmas displays.

Each sleek obelisk features a shimmering gold-toned PET and metal weave design, complemented by soft warm white micro LEDs. ## Features
- The back of the panel is made of flexible plastic
- It creates Good atmosphere.
- Perfect for birthday, wedding party, decorations
- Silk material of panels looks like real flowers

## Information
Each flower panel comes with a plastic grid in the back. Connect flower panels to form a wall by tying them together with a zip tie safety pin through the plastic grid. Secure the flower wall by tying the edges of the panel to a wall, pole, or other rigid structure. It is easy to transport and store, and this size allows you to custom your flower walls to any combination and size. These artificial fake flowers are well made, soft and come in vibrant and natural colour combination, which gives the appearance of a real flower. Silk flower walls are also a preferred choice for photographers as a decorous floral backdrop that has a timeless elegance. To clean this flower panel, simply blow off the dust on the flowers with a hairdryer. Some small leaves and flowers are not suitable for washing hence it is recommended to wipe them with a wet cloth instead of washing.

## Features
- Rich variety: this static snowflake window decoration Christmas set contains 9 stickers, each 30 x 20 cm with a total of 143 incomparable patterns. Combined with classic Christmas patterns
- High-quality window decoration: our Christmas window stickers are made of static self-adhesive PVC material, which is waterproof and reusable. The PVC Christmas decorations are printed with double-sided printing technology
- Easy to use: only four steps are required for installation: first clean the surface with a damp cloth. Then peel off the static adhesive stickers and stick them to a smooth surface. Then press out the water and bubbles with a card.
- Applicable scenarios: Christmas window sticker is suitable for all clean, smooth and flat surfaces such as windows, glass, mirrors, doors, tiles, fridges, etc. These Christmas pictures can decorate family parties
- Perfect gift: window decoration Christmas children for windows is the best gift for family, friends and children. Your children or friends will feel fun and satisfied when they receive this Christmas window sticker

## Information
These reusable Christmas static window stickers bring festive charm to homes and shops, featuring classic festive motifs including Santa, reindeer, snowflakes, Christmas trees and gift boxes available in white, red or blue colour options. Made from durable PVC static film and printed double-sided for clear viewing from inside and outside windows, this set includes nine sheets sized 30 x 20 cm; they require no glue, peel away cleanly without leaving marks or damaging glass and can be stored safely and reused year after year. Simply clean your window surface before fitting, and lightly spray water to help the static cling stick more securely onto smooth surfaces, though these decals are not suitable for rough textured walls. You can freely combine the different patterns to create your own unique winter display and build a warm, magical Christmas atmosphere in your space.

## Information
Brighten up your garden or other outdoor space this Christmas with our festive set of Candy Cane Lights. Perfect for lighting up a pathway or bedding area, the pack includes 8 Candy Canes each standing at 40cm tall and featuring 8 LED lights per cane, making 64 lights in total. The lights are programmed to run for 6 hours from each button press followed by a period of 18 hours off and then automatically coming back on again. This can be overridden with a press of the button. Each Candy Cane is supplied with a detachable ground stake to ensure your lights remain firmly fixed when in position and all materials are waterproof so you can leave out in your garden whatever the weather.

## Features
- Set of 20 soft multi colour stake lights
- 6h on 18h off timer
- Battery operated (3 x AA Not included)
- Indoor or outdoor
- 8 functions

## Information
Lumineo set of 20 mini coloured LED mushroom stake lights. Create a warm and welcoming festive atmosphere to your indoor or outdoor space with these mini battery powered mushroom style stake lights. The soft multi coloured light makes ideal lighting for a pathway, in and around plant pots or simply a festive decoration around the home. The lights are battery powered and require 3 x AA batteries which are not included. The handy timer function allows 6 hours on and 18 hours off, automatically turning on and off at the same time each day. The lights feature an 8 function twinkle effect creating an extra magical touch to your festive decorations. Each mushroom light stands at approximately 20cm tall including the ground spike, and the mushroom head measures approximately 4cm in diameter. Ideal for pushing into a plant pot, gravel or garden edge to enhance your Christmas lighting display. In total, the lit length is 3.8m with a spacing of 20cm between each light and a 30cm lead cable from battery box to first light.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Indoor water fountain (also outdoor use)
- Plug & play (2m lead cable)
- No constant water supply required
- 1x Cool white LED
- Diameter 18cm x Height 23cm approx.

## Information
Small Single Robin Water Fountain. NATURAL CHARM - Bring a touch of tranquil charm to your home or garden with the small polyresin robin water fountain. Designed for both indoor and outdoor use, this beautifully detailed water feature creates a peaceful ambiance with the gentle sound of flowing water, enhanced by a cool white LED light that adds a soft, soothing glow at any time of day. PERFECT FOR RELAXATION - The soft sound of flowing water provides a calming and stress-relieving effect, perfect for unwinding in your outdoor space. The fountain may also attract real birds looking for a refreshing drink or bath, adding even more charm to your garden. An integrated cool white LED illuminates the flowing water, creating a beautiful nighttime ambiance. Perfect for evening relaxation or entertaining guests, this feature enhances your outdoor setting even after the sun goes down. COMPACT AND VERSATILE - Measuring 18cm in length, 18cm in width, and 23cm in height, this fountain is Small enough to fit on tabletops, shelves, or garden corners, yet impactful enough to elevate your space with calming visual and audio appeal. Made from high-quality poly resin, this fountain is lightweight, weather-resistant, and designed to replicate the look of natural stone and wood without the weight or maintenance. SELF CONTAINED SYSTEM - This water feature operates on a closed-loop system, meaning you simply fill the reservoir, and the built-in pump continuously recirculates the water. This eliminates the need for an external water connection, making installation easy. Simply place the fountain in your desired location, fill it with water, and plug it in, no complicated installation required! The low-maintenance design ensures you only need to occasionally clean the pump and top up the water. Transformer must be located in a weatherproof socket. PLUG AND PLAY - Simple plug-and-play operation with no plumbing required. Just fill with water, plug in, and enjoy. The poly resin surface is also easy to wipe clean when needed. Powered by a safe, mains-operated pump with a 2-metre cable, giving you flexibility in positioning the fountain wherever it suits your space best.

## Features
- Made of PE and PVC
- 100 warm white LED lights
- 8 lighting functions
- Battery operated (requires 6x AA batteries)
- Suitable for indoor and covered outdoor use
- Red Poinsettia flowers

## Information
Mix your Christmas décor with the traditional beauty of the Noel Poinsettia Christmas Garland. Stretching to an impressive length of 9ft, this Xmas garland is designed to wrap your mantelpiece in a rich tapestry of festive cheer. Crafted with a blend of PVC and PE materials, the faux fir branches have a full-bodied, realistic appearance that forms a lush green base. Nestled within are iconic symbols of the season: vibrant red poinsettia blossoms, natural-looking pine cones, and clusters of snow-kissed berries. This garland provides a sophisticated focal point for your fireplace, adding warmth and texture to any room. No Christmas display is complete without the warm glow of light. This garland comes pre-lit with 100 warm white LED lights that are energy-efficient and long-lasting, casting a cosy and inviting atmosphere. The lighting is completely battery-operated, requiring 6x AA batteries (not included), which means you can place this garland anywhere without worrying about proximity to power outlets or unsightly cords. A simple, discreet controller allows you to choose from 8 different lighting functions, ranging from a steady-on glow to dynamic patterns like slow-fade, twinkle, and sequential, letting you customise the setting for any occasion. Designed for modern convenience, the Noel Poinsettia garland features an intelligent 6-hour on/18-hour off timer. Once set, the garland will light up at the same time each day, operate for six hours, and then automatically switch off for the next eighteen, maximising battery life and ensuring a worry-free experience throughout the season. The durable construction is designed for year-over-year use, requiring only minimal fluffing from storage to regain its full, verdant look. For best results and longevity, this product is recommended for indoor or sheltered outdoor use, allowing you to create beautiful, festive scenes without a lot of effort.

## Features
- Beautiful Christmas decoration
- Striking reindeer design
- Turns your home into a winter wonderland

## Information
Turn your home and garden into a true winter wonderland with this impressive and majestic LED Festive Reindeer Decoration. This festive light decoration has been elegantly crafted into a reindeer shape, giving it the impression of movement for a striking look, and has been studded with over 1000 LED lights that glow bright white in the dark. Perfect for standing in your back garden or out by your doorstep, this reindeer would look perfect on its down and also works well with other standing decorations to create a Christmas-themed scene. The ideal decorative accessory for any home over the winter, the reindeer comes with a 5m lead wire so you can plug it in almost anywhere with convenience.
